# Route access pin: every route in buildHTTPHandlers (DEV_MODE off).
# Each block: route, the request path used, then one line per method and identity.
# Identities: anonymous; viewer, operator, admin sessions; key-no-scope (admin role,
# only scope "search:none"); key-other-asset (admin role, scope "*", device nas02 only).
# Subtree routes are called with device nas01 appended. Requests have no body.
# "skipped" lines are calls not made; the reason is in routePinExceptions.
# Regenerate: LABTETHER_UPDATE_WIRING_PINS=1 go test -count=1 -run 'TestWiringPin' ./cmd/labtether

== / (probe /)
GET    anonymous       200
GET    viewer          200
GET    operator        200
GET    admin           200
GET    key-no-scope    200
GET    key-other-asset 200
POST   anonymous       405 "method not allowed"
POST   viewer          405 "method not allowed"
POST   operator        405 "method not allowed"
POST   admin           405 "method not allowed"
POST   key-no-scope    405 "method not allowed"
POST   key-other-asset 405 "method not allowed"

GET    viewer          403 "operator role required"
GET    operator        panic "runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"
GET    admin           panic "runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"
GET    key-no-scope    403 scope=terminal:read
GET    key-other-asset panic "runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference"
POST   anonymous       401 "unauthorized"
POST   viewer          403 "forbidden"
POST   operator        405 "method not allowed"
POST   admin           405 "method not allowed"
POST   key-no-scope    403 scope=terminal:write
POST   key-other-asset 405 "method not allowed"
